summary: The production and technology screens' tooltip builders read whole, with the ten shares' own tooltips, a build queue line's, the technology screen's four entries', and what `£` draws in a text.

addresses.name: CProductionView::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CProductionView::BuildTooltip(CProductionView* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element)
addresses.comment: **Slot 10** of CProductionView (vftable 0x15DED24): CONVOYS, LEDGER_ESCORTS, NEED, EFFECT, AMOUNT, NUKE_PRODUCTION / NO_NUKE_PRODUCTION, SLIDER_LOCKED_TOOLTIP / _UNLOCKED_TOOLTIP, STRAT_DET_RES_TT, THEATRE_ASSIGN_TROOPS_DESC, THEATRE_RECALC_DESC. The one caller of BuildProductionPenaltyTooltip (0x3F5A40) at 0x80174A. Body not read beyond the key list and the call. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-uinumbers.md. Signature corrected 2026-10-02 by the signature audit (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-sigaudit.md). **Read whole 2026-10-11.** `out` at [ebp+8] and the element at [ebp+0xC]. Its builder windows answer first. Then by the element's name: the seven resources' icon, label and value give BuildGoodsLedgerTooltip (energy 5, metal 4, rm 6, oil 3, supplies 0, money 2, fuel 1); strat_icon_in_prod STRAT_DET_RES_TT (NAME, EFFECT the country's scaled copy's every value, FROM a line per province of player_strategic_resource_provinces with that resource: its infrastructure over MaxInfrastructure, coloured at 330 and 990); nuke_icon/nukes_label/nukes_value NUKE_PRODUCTION or NO_NUKE_PRODUCTION by the technology status's +0xBC; a slider's six parts the share's slot 5 at the slider's position over TotalIC, rounded to a 32768th, with SLIDER_LOCKED_TOOLTIP or _UNLOCKED_TOOLTIP delayed on ds_SliderButton; theatres_calc_button THEATRE_RECALC_DESC; theatres_assign_button THEATRE_ASSIGN_TROOPS_DESC; escort LEDGER_ESCORTS and, disabled, NEED and the first technology with allow_escorts; needs the AI need line; convoy CONVOYS; underground, disabled, CCountry_UndergroundUnavailableText. Any other element: each capital building's button its name and, disabled, NEED and the technology that unlocks it; and the lines of trade_list (0x803FD0), build_queue (BuildQueueLineTooltip) and convoy_queue (BuildConvoyEfficiencyTooltip) that hold the element. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 1 to 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the slider arm off listing 0x800A1B..0x800B60, the strategic resource lines off 0x800346..0x8006C0, the escort and building arms off 0x800E10..0x800FC0 and 0x8013F7..0x801560; the call at 0x801746 loads the element from [ebp+0xC].
addresses.revises: Every arm described; the second argument is the element.

addresses.name: BuildQueueLineTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall BuildQueueLineTooltip(CGuiObject* element@ECX, void* line@stack:4, GuiTooltipText* out@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The whole tooltip of a build queue line, read 2026-10-11.** The element in ECX, the line, then `out` ([ebp+0xC], filled through EBX). The construction is the line's +0x78 id pair resolved by ResolvePersistentIdInPlace. original_country PW_ORIGINAL; cancel PEN_CANCEL_PRODU with PEN_CANCEL_PRODU_DRO + "\n\n" + CANCEL_MULTI_CONSTRUCTIONS_DESC delayed; max_prio, prio, non_prio, max_non_prio the PEN_* keys; counter_type, production_queue_division/_air/_naval, series_info and unit_target, for a unit with items (+0x84), an upgrade's BRIGADE_UPGRADE_MIL_CON_INFO (inherited experience delayed) or one line per item "£" + type key + " " + its name, then BRIGADE_MIL_CON_CUMULATED_EXP of +0xA4; anything else PEN_FULL_SPEED, PEN_PARTIAL_PROGRESS (status x 100, cut) or PEN_NO_PROGRESS by status (+0x3C). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the prologue 0x7F5A5F loads `out` from [ebp+0xC] into EBX; the unit arm off listing 0x7F6414..0x7F66A0; the caller at 0x801738..0x80174A pushes out then the line.
addresses.revises: Renamed: it is the whole line's tooltip, not only its penalties; the stack arguments were the wrong way round.

addresses.name: CDistributeLendLease::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. An empty tooltip. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.

addresses.name: CDistributeConsumerGoods::GetTooltip
addresses.comment:
Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. "
" + DCG_TOTAL_NEED (GetConsumerGoodsNeeded + MODIFIER_DISSENT, x100) + "
"; DCG_TROOPS_GOODS (GetStandingArmyConsumerDemand x100, land_brigades_in_service) + "
"; slot 9 for modifier 40 at war or 41 at peace; and where GetDissentChange at this share is not 0, "
" + DCG_DISSENT (§G below 0, §R+ above) + " ". See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; the kind at 0x51985A is 40 + (at_war == 0); GetDissentChange gets [ebp+0xC..0x10] at 0x5198CF.

addresses.name: CDistributeProduction::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_PRODUCTION: VAL = IC x share / needed x 100, undivided when needed <= 0; USE spent_beyond_free; NEED needed; FormatFixed15 to two places. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; the keys VAL, USE, NEED.

addresses.name: CDistributeSupply::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_SUPPLIES: VAL §R or §G+ by GetSuppliesMade, two places, §W; IC = share x 100. Then slot 9 for modifier 27 with nothing between, and "\n" + FROM_TECHNOLOGY + ": §G+" + the technology status's +0x9C x 100 + "%§W\n" where it is not 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.

addresses.name: CDistributeReinforcement::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_REINFORCE: VAL = IC x share / reinforcement_cost x 100, undivided when the cost <= 0; then " " + DCG_REINFORCE_BONUS with 1000 + MODIFIER_REINFORCEMENT_BONUS to one place, cut, where above 1000. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; the cost off CCountry +0xA98, the bonus off modifier values +0x2B0.

addresses.name: CDistributeUpgrade::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_UPGRADE (UNITS its own +0x20 to no places, IC upgrade_cost) and straight after, DCG_UPGRADE_BAD (IC x share / upgrade_cost x 100) where the share's IC is below the cost, else DCG_UPGRADE_OK. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.

addresses.name: CDistributeNCO::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_OFFICERS: VAL = leadership x share x LEADERSHIP_TO_OFFICERS x (1 + MODIFIER_OFFICER_RECRUITMENT), one place; then slot 9 for modifier 82 after a "\n" where it is longer than two characters. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; the kind 0x52 pushed at 0x51E31D; the length test at 0x51E32C.

addresses.name: CDistributeDiplomacy::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_DIPLOMACY: VAL = leadership x share x LEADERSHIP_TO_DIPLOMACY, UPKEEP GetInfluenceUpkeep, two places. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; the keys VAL and UPKEEP.

addresses.name: CDistributeEspionage::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_ESPIONAGE: VAL = leadership x share x LEADERSHIP_TO_SPIES, two places. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.

addresses.name: CDistributeResearch::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: Slot 5: what the share would do at a slider's position, `share` a 48.15 number. DCG_RESEARCH: SPEED = leadership x share, COUNT the projects (+0x640), PERCENT §R under 1 else §G, then SPEED / COUNT (1 with none) x 100 to two places and %§W. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; the keys SPEED, COUNT, PERCENT.

addresses.name: CCountry_CanTrainUnderground
addresses.comment: Whether the underground button is enabled: at war, not a government in exile, and a province with no unit held by an enemy that is not the country, not REB and not its friend - among its allies' provinces when it is a major or has more than 100 MaxIC, then its own, which for a small country must be its own. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; bare `ret`; the country read through EDI.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetUndergroundUnavailableText
addresses.comment: The underground button's tooltip when disabled: UNDERGROUND_NOT_AT_WAR at peace, nothing for a government in exile, else the same walk as CCountry_CanTrainUnderground - nothing where a province qualifies, UNDERGROUND_NOT_AT_WAR where none does. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 6.

addresses.name: ResolvePersistentIdInPlace
addresses.comment: Looks the id pair at ESI up in the low or high persistent table (type above 0x1268) and writes the object, or 0, over its first dword. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 5.

addresses.name: GetQueuedBrigadeName
addresses.comment: Copies the string at a build queue item's +0x18, its name, into `out`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 5.

addresses.name: Fixed15FromFloat
addresses.comment: A float as a 48.15 number: value x 32768.0 (0x160A348) plus 0.5 at or above 0 and -0.5 below, then the 64-bit truncation at 0xC088A6 - rounded half away from 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 4.

addresses.name: CTechnologyView::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CTechnologyView::BuildTooltip(CTechnologyView* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: Slot 10 of CTechnologyView. Custom game buttons first (+0x1A4, +0x198, +0x19C, +0x1A0); a slider's parts the leadership share's slot 5 at the position over TotalLeadership, the lock line delayed; leader_ship_label BASE (the controlled provinces' +0x324 and local leadership modifiers), slot 9 for modifiers 33 and 35, FROM_TECHNOLOGY of the status's +0xB8 and SHARE_TECH_TOOLTIP lines; the tree entries (+0x160) through CTechTreeEntry::OwnsElement and their slot 0; the theories and practicals; the current_research lines' slot 12; and with the panel up its input_box icons' slot 12, start (TTE_ALREADY, START_RESEARCH with DAYS, or DescribeWhyNotResearchable), icon_finish_type ICON_FINISH and difficulty DIFFICULTY_TECH. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 1, 2, 6, 7.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the leadership label off listing 0x81FDCE..0x8203B5 (the tooltip at [esp+0xD8]), the days off 0x820C55..0x820E56; `ret 8`.

addresses.name: CTechTreeEntry::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CTechTreeEntry::BuildTooltip(CTechTreeEntry* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment:
CTechTreeEntry's one virtual slot: the tooltip of a tree entry, from its keys - TTE_ALREADY, LEVEL, LOWEST_TECH_LEVEL, TECH_DC_TO_START, TECH_DC_TO_STOP and three CGM_TOOLTIP_* shortcuts. Not read; named by analogy with the other tooltip slots. **Read whole 2026-10-11:** `text` = name + " (" + level + ")

", level being the country's plus one or 1 for a technology of one level; where CanResearch says no, TTE_ALREADY on the queue or DescribeWhyNotResearchable, then "
"; then BuildEffectsText at that level; delayed_extra TECH_DC_TO_STOP or TECH_DC_TO_START, or with custom game settings LOWEST_TECH_LEVEL and the three shortcut lines. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 3.

addresses.name: CCurrentResearchEntry::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CCurrentResearchEntry::BuildTooltip(CCurrentResearchEntry* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element)
addresses.comment: **Slot 12** of CCurrentResearchEntry (vftable 0x15DFD4C) - research efficiency and the priority penalties: MODIFIER_RESEARCH_EFFICIENCY, PEN_MAX_PRIO, PEN_PRIO, PEN_NON_PRIO, PEN_MAX_NON_PRIO, TECH_SUSPEND, TECH_TREE_INFO, FROM_TECHNOLOGY, LEVEL. `ret 8`, receiver in ECX (spilled to [ebp-0x60] at 0x816A3B), 0xB1A bytes to the `ret 8` at 0x81709F with code past it. It calls CCountryTag::GetCountry at 0x816A55. A list entry on the technology screen, so it reads which row it is. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-uinumbers.md. **Read whole 2026-10-11:** tech_prio_maxup PEN_MAX_PRIO, tech_prio_up PEN_PRIO, tech_prio_down PEN_NON_PRIO, tech_prio_maxdown PEN_MAX_NON_PRIO, cancel TECH_SUSPEND, else TECH_TREE_INFO for a technology of many levels; then every arm joins at 0x816BAF: slot 9 for modifier 73, and the status's research_efficiency - "\n" + MODIFIER_RESEARCH_EFFICIENCY + ":\n", the FROM_TECHNOLOGY line where it is above 0, and the list where it is longer than one character. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the joins off listing 0x8171B1..0x817525; the kind 0x49 at 0x816BCC.
addresses.revises: The arms and the efficiency block described.

addresses.name: CTechSkillEntry::BuildTooltip
addresses.comment: A theory or practical's tooltip: its category's name (slot 0); with custom game settings CGM_TOOLTIP_THEORY_PRACTICE after it; where category_shared_from is set, TW_SKILL_SHARE delayed with COUNTRY, THEIR (the higher level) and OUR, one place each. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 4.

Only for its own tech_icon: TECH_ICON_SPEED_MOD with NAME the category's, SKILL (+0x30) to one place, PERCENT the weight (+0x34) x 100 to none, and SPEED §R or §G+ by sign and FormatFixedPointTrimmed of +0x2C x 100. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 6.

addresses.name: DescribeWhyNotResearchable
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __fastcall DescribeWhyNotResearchable(Hoi3CString* out, CTechnology* technology, int tag, int countryId) @EAX
addresses.comment: ALREADY_RESEARCHED for a technology of one level the country has; otherwise the allow trigger (+0x248) slot 9 with a scope of the country. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 8`; ECX out, EDX the technology.

addresses.name: CTechnology_YearPenalty
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CTechnology_YearPenalty(CTechnology* technology@ECX, int level@EAX, int* out@ESI, int year@stack:4)
addresses.comment: 1000, plus (due - year) x 1000 x TECHNOLOGY_YEAR_IMPACT / 1000 where the level is due after `year`: start_year for level 1, first_offset for 2, additional_offset more for each past it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 7.

addresses.name: CCountry_ResearchEfficiency
addresses.comment: 1000 + MODIFIER_RESEARCH_EFFICIENCY (values +0x248) + the status's research_efficiency (+0xA8), never below g_MinimumResearchEfficiency. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 7.

structs.name: CEntryForTechCategory
structs.comment: A category icon inside a technology's input_box, on a tree entry or on the panel for one technology: the window tech_category_entry and the figures its tooltip shows. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 6.
structs.evidence: RTTI names the vftable 0x15DFCB0; the constructor 0x813EC0 writes it and fills +0x28..+0x34.

struct_fields.name: items
struct_fields.comment: Head of the list of what a military construction builds, one item per brigade: +0x18 its name, +0x34 its type, +0x38 the type it upgrades from, +0x40 the experience it inherits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 5.

struct_fields.name: item_count
struct_fields.comment: How many items the list at +0x7C holds. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 5.

struct_fields.name: accumulated_experience
struct_fields.comment: Thousandths: what the queue line's BRIGADE_MIL_CON_CUMULATED_EXP shows to two places. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md, section 5.

struct_fields.name: category
struct_fields.comment: The theory or practical the icon is for. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 6.

struct_fields.name: speed
struct_fields.comment: Thousandths: GetCategoryResearchAbility of the category, what TECH_ICON_SPEED_MOD's SPEED shows. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 6.

struct_fields.name: skill
struct_fields.comment: Thousandths: the country's level of the category, or its sharer's where higher. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 6.

struct_fields.name: weight
struct_fields.comment: Thousandths: the research_bonus_from weight of the category for this technology. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-techtooltip.md, section 6.
